nytimes_articles.abstract: French Pres Jacques Chirac announces plans for major new museum of African, Oceanic and pre-Columbian art; $200-million Museum of Civilization and Early Art, reflecting Chirac's own fascination with Africa, will combine collections of Museum of African and Oceanic Arts and Ethnology section of Museum of Man; photos; museum will be in Passy Wing of Palais de Chaillot in Trocadero section of Paris; opening is set for late 2001, just before Chirac's term ends; Chirac also orders dismayed Louvre officials to display African items in Salle des Sessions; curators accuse Chirac of political correctness, saying work is handicraft, not art (M)
